verdict.rationale: Relay's own marketing claims it can 'capture receipts, categorize expenses in real time, and sync everything to your accounting software automatically,' backed by real-time card transaction tracking and detailed sync to QuickBooks Online and Xero. However, the evidence never shows that receipts are captured automatically at the moment of card use. 'Capture receipts' may still require the user to upload a photo, and the coding depth is unproven. Missing for 10: evidence of zero-touch receipt capture triggered by card swipe, documentation of automatic coding/GL mapping rules, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
